title: Zucchini Spaghetti in Pink Sauce
subtitle: with goat's cheese rosa sauce and feta
description: Zucchini ribbons tossed with a tomato sauce blended with soft goat's cheese into a creamy pink sauce, finished with parsley and goat's feta.

steps.text: Cut the zucchini into long thin strips with a julienne peeler. If you don't have one, slice the zucchini lengthways with a regular peeler and cut the slices into thin sticks.
Cook the sauce ingredients, except the goat's cheese, in a covered pot for 12-15 minutes. Cool.
Blend the tomato sauce with the goat's cheese to a velvety pink sauce. Taste and add salt and pepper only if needed.
Toss the zucchini strips with the sauce, sprinkle with chopped parsley and crumbled goat's feta and serve immediately.
